spans.s:
(उ) झमु r. 1st cl. (झमति)
To eat: see जमु, &c.

mf. (-म्पः-म्पा)
Jumping, springing, plunging.
E.
झं imitative sound, and पत to fall, affix ड.

m. (-कः)
A monkey or ape.
E.
झम्प, and अक to go.

m. (-रुः)
A monkey, an ape.
E.
झम्प plunging, and ऋ to go, उण् aff.

m. (-शी)
A kingfisher.
E.
झम्प plunging, and अश to eat, affix णिनि.

m. (-म्पी)
A monkey, an ape.
E.
झम्प springing, इनि aff.

n. (-कं)
A burnt or vitrified brick.
E.
झम to eat, affix ण्वुल, being fed upon by fire.

m. (-रः)
A small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spindles, needles, &c.
E.
झाम eating, wearing away, from झम to eat, affix घञ्, and र what gets, from रा with ड aff.
